name: AFFiNE
description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
one_liner: A privacy-first, open-source app that combines a Notion-style notes/wiki with a Miro-style whiteboard in one tool you can run yourself instead of trusting a cloud company with your data.
buyer: A privacy-conscious small business or team (e.g. a law firm or healthcare startup) that wants Notion-like planning tools but can't put sensitive data in a Big Tech cloud.
business_use_cases: A law firm self-hosts it as an internal wiki and case-planning board, satisfying client-confidentiality requirements Notion can't meet.
An agency offers 'self-hosted AFFiNE setup and theming' as a productized service for privacy-sensitive clients.
A startup studio builds and sells a custom AFFiNE template pack (OKRs, roadmaps, sprint boards) for teams migrating off Notion.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed self-hosting (set up, update, back up AFFiNE) for privacy-sensitive SMBs.
Sell premium template packs for common team workflows.

steal_this: Package a one-click 'self-hosted AFFiNE for your law firm/clinic' deployment service and pitch it directly to a few local privacy-regulated businesses.
